notes: New Timeline Edits: Z Axis Fix (leaders behind boxes), Date Snap (align leaders to the datebar), Place Entry at Top; plus Formats > Auto Center. Entries use date-encoded shape names and show MMM D dates (year shown on the bar); both makers now draw on the current slide, and the edit tools work on a copied timeline. Includes the 5.5.1 set: weighted/tiered column widths, multi-lane packing, torn bar at gaps, Tear Gap, Toggle Weighted Timeline, Space Evenly, the Copilot conversion prompt, a Bates/document column, and Excel/CSV import.
